column1: # Heart (Chalice), the Kolima secret boss. Also names rows 101 and 104.

column3: Matthew...\nNo. It can't be.\nNot that face again.{end_wait}
My name is Isaac.\nI don't know Matthew.\nYou've mistaken me.{end_wait}
That face... those eyes.\nI know what I saw.\nYou can't fool me.{end_wait}
I paid for that defeat.\nEvery scar is a debt.\nAnd you will pay.{end_wait}
I won't lose again.\nNot to you, Matthew.\nNot this time.{end_wait}
I'm not your enemy.\nBut I won't let you\nhurt anyone else.{end_wait}
No... Not again...\nAfter everything...\nAfter what I became...{end_wait}
It's over.\nYou can't keep fighting.\nI'm not Matthew.{end_wait}

Liar... I know those eyes.
That same damned face...{page_break}I lost my pride.
My face. Everything.
I'll never forgive you.{end_wait}
You don't get to decide.\nI won't forgive that face.\nNot while I live.{end_wait}
